name: prayer-times
title: Prayer Times
description: Prayer times in root search and the menu bar, kept in Apple Reminders two weeks ahead with start, jamaat and ending notifications.
author: smrehan

commands.name: next-prayer
commands.title: Next Prayer
commands.subtitle: Prayer Times
commands.description: Keeps the next prayer in its root search subtitle and keeps prayer reminders filled ahead. Open it to see today's prayers.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Prayer Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Prayer Times
commands.description: Shows the prayer in the menu bar when it starts, before jamaat, and before it ends until you mark it prayed.

commands.name: today
commands.title: Today's Prayers
commands.subtitle: Prayer Times
commands.description: Start and jamaat times for today, prayed status, and the last 7 days.

commands.name: prayer-calendar
commands.title: Prayer Calendar
commands.subtitle: Prayer Times
commands.description: A month calendar of prayer status. Open any day to see its prayers, mark or change them, and expand each one for its times.

commands.name: set-location
commands.title: Set Prayer Location
commands.subtitle: Prayer Times
commands.description: Pick your country and city from searchable lists, or use your current location, refreshed 30 minutes before each prayer.

commands.name: jamaat-formulas
commands.title: Jamaat Formula Guide
commands.subtitle: Prayer Times
commands.description: How to write a jamaat rule as a formula, like ceil(start, 15) + 15, with today's result or error for each prayer.

commands.name: prayer-alert
commands.title: Prayer Alert
commands.subtitle: Prayer Times
commands.description: Optional Raycast popup for prayer start, jamaat and ending, with snooze. Off unless Alert Style includes the popup.

preferences.name: school
preferences.title: School
preferences.description: School of fiqh for when each prayer's time starts, when it ends, and when delaying it becomes disliked (makruh). Each rule below can override it.

preferences.name: method
preferences.title: Calculation Method
preferences.description: Fajr and Isha angles. Tehran and Ja'fari also set Maghrib after the eastern redness.

preferences.name: madhab
preferences.title: Asr Starts At
preferences.description: When an object's shadow is once or twice its length (plus its shadow at noon).

data.title: One Shadow Length (Shafi'i, Maliki, Hanbali, Ja'fari)

preferences.name: asrPreferred
preferences.title: Asr Preferred Until
preferences.description: Asr stays valid until sunset; after this, delaying it is disliked.

data.title: Sun Turns Yellow, About 20 Min Before Sunset (Hanafi, Maliki)

preferences.name: dhuhrEndsAtShafiAsr
preferences.title: Dhuhr Ends At
preferences.label: End Dhuhr at the earlier (Shafi'i) Asr time
preferences.description: With two-shadow Asr: end Dhuhr when the shadow equals the object's length. Off by default: Dhuhr stays valid until Asr, and that earlier time is its preferred end. Not used for Ja'fari, whose Dhuhr is valid until sunset.

preferences.name: adjustments
preferences.title: Minute Adjustments
preferences.description: Shift start times to match your local timetable: Fajr,Dhuhr,Asr,Maghrib,Isha in minutes, e.g. 0,2,0,3,0.

preferences.name: maghribStart
preferences.title: Maghrib Starts At
preferences.description: Sunset (Sunni schools) or once the eastern redness has gone, about 15–20 min later (Ja'fari).

preferences.name: maghribEnd
preferences.title: Maghrib Ends At
preferences.description: After this Maghrib is late. Isha's start follows the calculation method's Isha angle.

preferences.name: maghribPreferred
preferences.title: Maghrib Preferred Until
preferences.description: After this, delaying Maghrib is disliked.

data.title: Stars Appear, About 35 Min After Sunset (Hanafi)
Short Window, About 25 Min After Sunset (Maliki)

preferences.name: ishaEnd
preferences.title: Isha Ends At
preferences.description: After this Isha is late.

preferences.name: ishaPreferred
preferences.title: Isha Preferred Until
preferences.description: After this, delaying Isha is disliked.

data.title: First Third of the Night (Shafi'i, Maliki, Hanbali, Ja'fari)

preferences.name: lateAt
preferences.title: Counts as Late After
preferences.description: Which end the ending reminder, the red menu bar countdown and on-time history use. After a prayer's preferred end the menu bar turns orange either way.

preferences.name: jamaatFajr
preferences.title: Fajr Jamaat
preferences.description: Fixed HH:MM (24h), +N minutes after start, floor5+N (round start down to 5 min, add N), ceil5+N, end-N (N minutes before the prayer time ends), a formula such as ceil(start, 15) + 15 (see Jamaat Formula Guide), or empty for none.

preferences.name: jamaatDhuhr
preferences.title: Dhuhr Jamaat
preferences.description: Same format as Fajr Jamaat.

preferences.name: jamaatJumuah
preferences.title: Jumu'ah Jamaat
preferences.description: Friday Dhuhr, same format as Fajr Jamaat. Empty uses the Dhuhr rule.

preferences.name: jamaatAsr
preferences.title: Asr Jamaat
preferences.description: Same format as Fajr Jamaat, or dhuhr+N for N minutes after Dhuhr's jamaat (prayed together, Ja'fari).

preferences.name: jamaatMaghrib
preferences.title: Maghrib Jamaat
preferences.description: Same format as Fajr Jamaat.

preferences.name: jamaatIsha
preferences.title: Isha Jamaat
preferences.description: Same format as Fajr Jamaat, or maghrib+N for N minutes after Maghrib's jamaat (prayed together, Ja'fari).

preferences.name: dueAt
preferences.title: Reminder Due Time
preferences.description: When each prayer reminder is due. Jamaat falls back to start for prayers without a jamaat rule.

preferences.name: headsUpMinutes
preferences.title: Heads-Up (Minutes)
preferences.description: Extra notification this many minutes before the due time (start or jamaat); the menu bar countdown turns yellow from then. 0 turns it off.

preferences.name: startWindowMinutes
preferences.title: Just Started (Minutes)
preferences.description: For this many minutes after a prayer starts, its menu bar count (e.g. "Asr +3") shows in green, then blue.

preferences.name: preferredReminderMinutes
preferences.title: Before Preferred End (Minutes)
preferences.description: The menu bar masjid turns from dark to light green this many minutes before the preferred time ends.

preferences.name: endingReminderMinutes
preferences.title: Ending Soon (Minutes)
preferences.description: Notify this many minutes before the prayer time ends; the menu bar masjid turns red from then. The menu bar keeps showing it until marked prayed.

preferences.name: jamaatReminderMinutes
preferences.title: Jamaat Reminder (Minutes)
preferences.description: Notify this many minutes before jamaat; the menu bar shows it from then.

preferences.name: useReminders
preferences.title: Apple Reminders
preferences.label: Keep prayers in Apple Reminders
preferences.description: Off: prayed status and history stay in Raycast only, and no reminders are created.

preferences.name: alerts
preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.description: Reminders alarms work on your iPhone and without Raycast running. The popup has Mark as Prayed and Snooze, but only while Raycast runs. The banner is the extension's own macOS notification, also only while Raycast runs.

preferences.name: menuBarShowNext
preferences.label: Always show the next prayer in the menu bar
preferences.description: A started prayer shows its time left (e.g. "Asr (-40)") until marked prayed or its time ends. The next prayer's countdown ("Maghrib -5") shows during the heads-up window, or all the time with this on.
preferences.title: Menu Bar

preferences.name: remindersList
preferences.title: Reminders List
preferences.description: Apple Reminders list for prayer reminders. Created if missing.

preferences.name: prayerNames
preferences.title: Prayer Names
preferences.description: English or Arabic names for the prayers in the menu bar, alerts and reminder titles.

preferences.name: daysAhead
preferences.title: Days Ahead
preferences.description: How many days of reminders to keep filled, starting today (1–31).

preferences.name: cleanMissedAfterDays
preferences.title: Clean Missed After (Days)
preferences.description: A missed prayer stays dated, showing as overdue in Reminders and Calendar, for this many days. After that its date is removed; it still counts as missed in history. 0 never removes it.
